content.summary: After H1 completes with valid receipts and zero-call resume, run the complete regression against the installed version 2 command and shared discrepancy repairs.
findings: H0 passed 39 focused checks, including actual reconsideration for candidate questions, incompatible supported programs and rejected proposals, plus late-deadline refusal and allowance-history integrity.

H1 must pass both the live command and retained-evidence audit before this phase can run. A retained non-executable reading or disputed source question is a valid unresolved result, not a reason to invent a program or force clearance.

H2 tests shared method changes and ordinary CLI wiring with the existing application, Java backend and assurance components. The fixed command uses trusted context and a 900-second whole-suite deadline.
Verify the protected round-nine implementation, source, sixteen jobs, model reservations and all accepted phase artifacts. Historical results must remain under their original method versions.

A test or integrity failure requires an executed repair, refreshed plan and new current-source review. Passing the suite supports engineering regression only; no independent legal accuracy, interpretation completeness, cost saving or bank release is established.
